DEPARTMENT OF COMPUTER SCIENCE & ENGINEERING
FAKE STANFORD AFFILIATE COLLEGE OF TECHNOLOGY
Date: October 24, 2024

To the Graduate Admissions Committee,

I am writing to offer my enthusiastic recommendation for Sneha Patel, who I have mentored as Thesis Advisor & Course Instructor during their study period (2020-2024) at Fake Stanford Affiliate College of Technology.

During this tenure, Sneha Patel demonstrated exceptional mastery in Computer Vision, OpenCV, TensorFlow, Edge AI. In our research laboratory, they led the pivotal development of 'Real-Time Deep Learning for Autonomous Mobile Perception', exhibiting remarkable technical intuition, rigorous experimental discipline, and intellectual maturity. Additionally, the candidate maintained an exemplary academic record with a GPA of 9.4 / 10.0.

Beyond technical competence, Sneha Patel displays genuine leadership, integrity, and proactive collaboration. I rank Sneha Patel among the top 1% of researchers I have supervised. I strongly recommend them for admission and financial fellowship without reservation.

Warm regards,

Dr. Arvind Swaminathan
Professor & Head of Department
Computer Science & Engineering
Fake Stanford Affiliate College of Technology
Email: .arvind.swaminathan@fakestanfo.edu
